title: GloBE ETR Jurisdiction Calculator
description: OECD Pillar Two GloBE ETR per jurisdiction. GloBE ETR = Adjusted Covered Taxes / GloBE Income (Art. 5.1.1). Minimum rate: 15%. SBIE deduction: qualifying payroll × transitional rate + qualifying tangible assets × transitional rate (Art. 5.3). Identifies jurisdictions below 15% for top-up tax computation (T474). ⚠ US-HQ groups exempt from IIR/UTPR per January 2026 OECD side-by-side package. First stage of the Pillar Two GloBE composer chain. Tier 1 Policy Mandate JSON + Markdown. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.

mcp_tool_definition.description: Calculate GloBE effective tax rate (ETR) per jurisdiction per OECD Pillar Two (Art. 5.1.1). ETR = Adjusted Covered Taxes / GloBE Income. Minimum 15%. SBIE deduction applied (Art. 5.3 transitional rates). Identifies jurisdictions below 15% for top-up tax (T474). ⚠ US-HQ groups exempt from IIR/UTPR per January 2026 OECD side-by-side package — do not apply IIR/UTPR to US-parented groups. Verify SBIE rates against current OECD Administrative Guidance. Synthetic data only.
